Senior Python Engineer 5 to 8 Years Experience

Location: Bangalore

Experience: 5 to 8 years

Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary:




We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Python Engineer with 5 to 8 years of experience, strong expertise in FastAPI,React, Pydantic, PostgreSQL, and AWS, and a deep understanding of advanced Python concepts. You will play a key role in designing and developing scalable backend services, ensuring performance, reliability, and clean code architecture.




Key Responsibilities:




Design and develop RESTful APIs using FastAPI and Pydantic for data validation.

UI Experience with React Js, with fullstack development

Build scalable and efficient backend services with PostgreSQL and AWS cloud services.

Write robust and maintainable code following SOLID principles and OOP best practices.

Implement unit and integration tests using Pytest to ensure high-quality code.

Apply design patterns, including Singleton, Factory, Strategy, etc., where appropriate.

Handle exceptions gracefully and implement error-handling strategies across services.

Use advanced Python features such as decorators, abstract base classes, and metaclasses when suitable.

Collaborate with DevOps, frontend, and product teams to deliver production-ready features.

Perform code reviews and mentor junior developers when needed.




Please share details and C.V to Vikram_Koteswararao@epam.com
